mentions.name: Jelly
mentions.description: This iOS camera app rolls the shutter and scores each picture as it comes in, telling the photographer when they have a good one where everybody's eyes are open and everyone is smiling.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://jelly.pictures - an iOS camera app that rolls the shutter and scores each pic as it comes in and tells the photographer when you have a good one, where everybody's eyes are open and is smiling.
